assessment_meta_description: Ask for a free evaluation for your dog: pick the dog, your free days, and add photos and videos if you like.
assessment_guide_pick: Hi! First tell me which friend of mine should go to {trainer}.
assessment_guide_when: Now tell me when you're usually free, so {trainer} can call.
assessment_guide_ready: All set! Add photos and videos too, if you have any.
assessment_guide_photos: Got the pictures! {trainer} will know my friend better.
assessment_guide_failed: Something's missing. Check the red bits.
assessment_guide_server_failed: I couldn't send it. The reason is below the form.
assessment_guide_sent: Delivered! Now we wait for {trainer}'s call.
assessment_guide_no_dogs: Where's my friend? Introduce them first!
assessment_guide_nothing: All my friends are either waiting for a call or already evaluated!
assessment_guide_files_speech: Photos and videos too, if you have any.
assessment_next_call_line: {trainer} calls you, you agree a time together, and she meets your dog in person.
assessment_next_courses_line: After the evaluation, the courses that suit your dog open up.
assessment_next_buy_line: After you buy, {trainer} calls and you arrange the sessions together.
assessment_header_lead: It's free and there's no obligation. Once {trainer} has seen your dog, its courses open up.
assessment_header_lead_sent: {trainer} will call you and you'll set a time together. Your receipt is right below.
assessment_form_dog_description: Pick the dog you'd like {trainer} to see. Every dog gets one free evaluation.
assessment_form_when_description: {trainer} will call and you'll set an exact time together. Here, just tell us when you're usually free.
assessment_form_files_description: A few photos and short videos of your dog help {trainer} get to know your dog.
assessment_form_busy: Wait for the uploads to finish
assessment_form_free_note: It's free and there's no obligation.
assessment_form_error_conflict: This dog already has an open request or a finished evaluation.
assessment_form_error_unauthorized: You've been signed out. Refresh the page and sign in again.
assessment_form_error_not_found: This dog is no longer in your account.
assessment_form_error_internal: The request wasn't saved. Try again.
assessment_form_error_internal_ref: The request wasn't saved. Try again. Reference number: {errorId}
assessment_form_error_network: The request wasn't saved. Check your internet connection and try again.
assessment_schema_periods: Pick at least one time of day.
assessment_schema_date_invalid: That date isn't on the calendar.
assessment_schema_date_past: The date can't be in the past.
assessment_when_days: Which days are you usually free?
assessment_media_max_photos: You can add up to {count} photos.
assessment_media_photo_too_big: This photo is larger than {size} MB.
assessment_media_max_videos: You can add up to {count} videos.
assessment_media_video_too_big: This video is larger than {size} MB.
assessment_media_hint: Up to {photos} photos (JPG or PNG) and {videos} videos; each video up to {size} MB, mp4 or mov.
assessment_media_drop: Drop photos and videos here or choose them
assessment_photo_error_generic: The photo couldn't be uploaded. Try again.
assessment_photo_error_heic: Send the photo as a JPG or PNG.
assessment_video_error_generic: The video couldn't be uploaded. Try again.
assessment_nothing_description: Each dog gets just one evaluation. Your dogs are either waiting for {trainer}'s call or already evaluated.
assessment_no_dogs_description: An evaluation is for one particular dog. Write its name and breed so {trainer} knows who to expect. Then you'll come straight back here.
assessment_error_description: Something went wrong. Open the page again or check back in a few minutes.
